items.text: Add the Notch badge style for genre, ranking and extra badges, in Cream, Glass, Ink and Gradient materials
Add a Notch step layout for separate ratings, with genre and year on the upper step
Add the Notch style to the quality and age badges: one tab on the poster edge, with Stacked (two floors) or Row (tier in a solid cell) layout
Add a Notch tab for separate ratings in the column, attached to the poster edge under the quality badges
Reorganize the separate ratings style picker by position, Column or Bottom, with a preview for every style
Add a Notch banner style to episode thumbnails
Group badge style pickers into families with a variants row, remembering your last choice per family
Choose low, medium or high image quality for posters and thumbnails on private instances
Deliver episode thumbnails as WebP or JPEG instead of PNG for lighter downloads
Refresh the home page: a larger poster with a before and after slider, style chips, and the poster wall behind the hero
Show the Ko-fi label next to its icon in the mobile header
Fit the editor selection frames to the visible badge instead of its shadow and padding
